shots.focal_element: Rising ELO PROGRESS line chart with a tiny plush Oscar figure tumbling down along the line
shots.typography: Chart title in bold uppercase geometric sans with slightly open tracking, muted grey; axis labels in the same sans at regular weight, grey. Final frame shows 'STALEMATE HELPER!' letters flying in (heavy rounded italic display, likely Duolingo's Feather-style face, low confidence).
shots.what_happens: The camera pushes/pans across a zoomed-in line chart from top-right towards the bottom-left as a small 3D plush Oscar slides and tumbles down the rising green line from the peak toward the 1125 start point, landing on VO 'elo progress' (w98-w99); at the end the next feature title letters start scattering in and the shot gives way to the board scene.
shots.build_rebuild: Render a static line chart (gridlines, dot markers, grey axis labels) larger than the frame, animate a camera pan from the last data point to the first over ~3 s while a character sprite follows the polyline path in reverse with a slight rotation wobble.

shots.focal_element: Bold 'STALEMATE HELPER!' title over a recreated chess board, with two fuzzy plush fingers (one tan, one green) poking in from left and right
shots.transition_other: Continuation of the board scene that appeared at the very end of s037; the title letters fly in and settle into a line (kinetic scatter-to-line assemble).
shots.typography: Speech bubble in clean regular-weight humanist sans, sentence case. Title in heavy rounded italic display, uppercase, tight tracking, white fill with thick dark-green offset outline/extrude (Duolingo Feather Bold-like, low confidence).
shots.what_happens: Phone-width app screen centred on a green field: the coach character (Oscar) at top with a speech bubble 'Look out for stalemate!', a near-empty board with a white king and dark king; real-footage plush fingers from both sides hover over the pieces as if playing. The title sits across the lower board, then streaks out to the right with a motion blur at ~57.5 s. VO 'Undo those pesky stalemate and' (w100-w104).
shots.build_rebuild: Composite a recreated app board panel with a character + speech-bubble header, overlay keyed live-action plush finger plates entering from left/right edges, and animate an outlined italic title that assembles from scattered letters and exits with a horizontal motion-blur slide right.

shots.focal_element: The black king on the board being blown up into rubble in a puff of smoke
shots.transition_other: Continuous with s038 (same board scene, no visible cut); detected split likely caused by the title exit and the camera starting to push in.
shots.typography: Speech bubble text in regular-weight humanist sans, sentence case, dark grey on white rounded bubble.
shots.what_happens: The plush fingers move pieces: the white queen slides up beside the kings, the camera pushes in on the column, a grey smoke puff erupts and the black king shatters into black rubble chunks on 'proper boom' (w110-w111), leaving a white halo above; Oscar's expression shifts from smug to wide-eyed. VO 'finish the match with a proper boom.' (w105-w111).
shots.build_rebuild: On the board composite, tween the queen to its target square, scale the camera ~1.4x toward the king column, then replace the black king sprite with a smoke-puff sprite sheet plus 6-8 rubble pieces that burst outward with a quick ease-out and settle, synced to the 'boom' word.

shots.focal_element: Bald plush figure with round wire glasses and a black turtleneck (a keynote-presenter parody) standing on a purple-lit stage
shots.what_happens: Very short (~0.3 s) bridge: the keyframe shows the puppet's face inside a blue-ringed circle expanding over the chess board (avatar-circle iris reveal), and the sheet frame at 61.0 s shows the circle has opened to full frame with the puppet standing on stage. No VO in the shot apart from the start of 'Oh,' (w112) at its tail.
shots.build_rebuild: Scale a circular mask with a blue stroke from a small avatar size to beyond the frame diagonal over ~0.3 s with a strong ease-in, revealing full-frame stage footage underneath the board composite.

shots.focal_element: Giant keynote screen reading 'ONE MORE THING...' above the small plush presenter, with an audience silhouetted in the foreground
shots.typography: Heavy rounded italic display, uppercase, tight tracking, white fill with dark outline/drop shadow, centred on a purple-blue gradient screen.
shots.what_happens: Wide keynote-stage parody: the camera has pulled back from the presenter to reveal a packed auditorium and the big screen with 'ONE MORE THING...', flanked by two flat white 2D 'thought cloud' doodles; held almost static while VO says 'Oh, and there's one more thing soon' (w112-w118). At ~63.0 s the frame already switches to the illustrated phones scene.
shots.build_rebuild: Cut to a wide stage plate with a keyed screen area, place the outlined italic headline centred on the screen, add two flat cloud doodles at the edges with a gentle bob, and hold for ~2 s with a slight slow push.

shots.focal_element: Two illustrated hands holding phones that show opponent profile cards 'Gab Lia, Elo 1250' and 'Tyler Murphy, Elo 1166'
shots.transition_other: Cut into a flat 2D illustration on a white field with pink and green brush-stroke vertical bands (could be a fast wipe; not resolvable at 2 fps).
shots.typography: Names in bold rounded sans, title case, dark grey; Elo lines in bold sans, teal-green, preceded by a small pulse/line icon. Card text is slightly rotated with the phones.
shots.what_happens: Flat cel-style illustration: two arms enter from left and right holding phones face-out, each showing a player avatar card; the phones drift and rotate slightly toward each other over painterly pink and green bands, previewing head-to-head matchmaking. VO 'you'll be able to play against other learners' (w119-w126).
shots.build_rebuild: Build two phone mockups as SVG/vector groups attached to arm shapes, position them left and right over two vertical brush-stroke bands, and animate a slow mirrored drift-and-rotate (±5 degrees) toward centre with a soft drop shadow under each phone.
